# KaTeX 0.16.22

Vendored from the npm package `katex@0.16.22` for offline-capable formula rendering.

- Upstream: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX
- Package SHA-1 reported by npm: d2b3d66464b1e6d69e6463b28a86ced5a02c5ccd
- Files: dist/katex.min.js, dist/katex.min.css, dist/contrib/auto-render.min.js, dist/fonts/*.

Render only text nodes. Untrusted TeX uses `trust: false`, bounded macro expansion and bounded size.
